description: This file is a PHP script for editing workflows in the vtiger CRM system. It manages workflow retrieval, creation from templates, permission checks, and rendering the workflow editing interface.

classes.name: VTWorkflowApplication
classes.description: Represents the workflow application context, used to manage workflow operations and URLs.

classes.name: VTWorkflowUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for permission checks and other workflow-related utilities.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine wrapper used for rendering the workflow edit page.

methods.name: vtWorkflowEdit
methods.description: Main function to handle editing workflows, including retrieval, creation, permission validation, and rendering the edit interface.
